results.name: Mr. Robot
results.overview: A young programmer, Elliot, suffers from a debilitating anti-social disorder and decides that he can only connect to people by hacking them. He wields his skills as a weapon to protect the people that he cares about. Elliot finds himself in the intersection between a cybersecurity firm he works for and the underworld organizations that are recruiting him to bring down corporate America.

known_for.title: Dance Music
known_for.overview: This film, promoted in Germany by Bravo Magazine to exploit the breakdance craze, actually featured very little breakdancing other than some (presumably second unit) footage of the notorious breakdancer, Mr. Robot.

results.title: Mr.Robot
results.overview: A futuristic world where robots have become popular, Tae-pyeong is possessed by a robot body in an unfortunate accident. He meets Nana, whose life is threatened by her evil uncle, who killed her brother to take over the company. The story of a robot who sacrifices his entire body to protect a child in danger.

results.name: Mr. Robot Digital After Show
results.overview: A live weekly online series, hosted by The Verge, that dives into the complexities of USA Network's critically acclaimed hacker drama, Mr. Robot. Each episode features an in-depth discussion about the most recent episode of Mr. Robot from both an artistic and technological perspective.

results.title: Mr. Robot: Behind the Mask
results.overview: Mr. Robot: Behind the Mask is a psychological documentary that explores the hidden emotional world behind the acclaimed series Mr. Robot. Moving beyond code, hacks, and conspiracies, this special dives into the inner lives of the characters—especially Elliot Alderson—and the masks they wear to survive in a broken society.

results.title: Mr. Robot_dec0d3d.doc
results.overview: In Mr. Robot Decoded, creator Sam Esmail, stars Rami Malek and Christian Slater, real-life hacker Jeff Moss and other experts open up about how the show made an extremely technical subject relatable to a wide audience and brought humanity to hackers through the main character Elliot Alderson.
